# KaTeX

This directory vendors the browser distribution of KaTeX 0.18.7 so formulas render on GitHub Pages without a CDN or runtime package installation.

- Project: https://katex.org/
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE` in this directory.
- Included: `katex.min.js`, `katex.min.css`, and the WOFF2, WOFF, and TTF fonts referenced by the stylesheet.
